verdict.rationale: GitHub documents multiple first-party AI-insight features drawing on user data/code: Copilot suggestions and refactoring, Agent mode that analyzes the codebase and explains/generates edits, Copilot Autofix for vulnerabilities, and security campaigns surfacing remediation suggestions. Community evidence (comm-11) corroborates that Copilot's code suggestions can feel genuinely helpful, supporting real-world use of these insights. Missing for 10: independent large-scale evaluation of suggestion/insight accuracy and quantified adoption data beyond anecdotal reports.
